header_line.description: First line shown in the banner (often includes system name or environment).

welcome_message.default:
This system is for authorized users only.
All activities may be monitored and recorded.
welcome_message.description: Primary welcome or authorization statement. Supports line breaks.

legal_notice.description: Optional legal disclaimer or terms of use. Leave empty to omit.

warning_lines.description: List of additional warning or usage restriction lines. Each entry appears on its own line.

items.description: One warning or policy line (e.g., 'Unauthorized access is prohibited.'

footer_line.description: Final separator or closing line. Leave empty to omit.
